candidates.name: Bell Plumbing and Heating
candidates.description: Bell Plumbing and Heating is a thriving residential plumbing, HVAC, and electrical service company. Locally owned for the better part of 93 years we know the expectations of our customers and have a team that strives to exceed them. We carry pride in the environment we share in our offices and the culture we have built as a company. We marvel at the dedication we see throughout every person that works here and in the effort that they put into their jobs every day. There is an all for one and one for all feeling that keeps our teams strong and productive. Denny Bell founded what would become Bell Plumbing and Heating in 1926 before the Internet, before cell phones, before color TV, before computers, before World War II, and before the Great Depression, automobiles and telephones had just made the scene. A handshake was a binding contract. Items in a dime store cost a dime or less. Through the years we have maintained the humble values on which Denny founded this company. Here we believe in family. We believe in doing things right. We believe in the higher road without shortcuts. It took generations to build us into the spectacular company we are today, and we plan to be around for many generations to come.
candidates.rationale: Same regional residential home services model with overlapping HVAC, plumbing, and electrical offerings to homeowners.

candidates.name: Service Champions
candidates.description: Service Champions is a nationally recognized leader in providing comprehensive home comfort solutions, including water heaters, filtration systems, electrical services, heating, air conditioning, and indoor air quality systems. With over 20 years of experience serving Northern California families, we are experts in maintenance, repair, and installation of all brands of HVAC systems. Our commitment to client satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Diamond Certified® Award for over 15 consecutive years, and recognition as a Bay Area Top Workplace every year since 2015. Our EPA-certified technicians undergo ongoing training to ensure the highest quality services and installations for the residents of the San Francisco Bay and Sacramento Valley areas. Trust Service Champions for all your home comfort needs.
candidates.rationale: Same multi-trade residential home services model; overlapping HVAC, plumbing-adjacent water heating/filtration, electrical, and local homeowner customer base.

candidates.name: Bradbury Brothers
candidates.description: Bradbury Brothers is a family-owned and operated company based in The Woodlands, Texas. Our family has been serving the air conditioning, plumbing, & electrical needs of our customers for over 30 years. We strive to provide the "Ultimate Service Experience"​ and have received "1st Place - Best of The Woodlands"​ eight years in a row. OUR MISSION is to help our customers identify "what they want"​ and "what they need "​ and to use those findings to make the "best choice"​ in regards to their air conditioning and heating needs. Our family gives you our personal promise that we won’t be happy until you’re 100% satisfied! We personally stand behind our people, our products, and our services. We’ll make sure we’ve kept all our promises to you or we’ll refund your money.
candidates.rationale: Regional home-services contractor offering HVAC, plumbing, and electrical to homeowners; same business model and buyer base as the seed.

candidates.name: Nexgen Air Conditioning Heating and Plumbing
candidates.description: Established in 2015, Nexgen Air Conditioning Heating and Plumbing is a full-service heating, plumbing, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) company serving Orange County, Los Angeles County, Riverside County, and Coachella Valley. With 15 plus years of experience in the HVAC industry, Nexgen Air Conditioning Heating and Plumbing provides residential customers with the best in customer care and services during installations, replacements, maintenance, and repairs. At Nexgen Air Conditioning Heating and Plumbing, we value loyalty and we want to serve you as your local air conditioning and heating company. Experience the Next Generation in Home Comfort with Nexgen Air Conditioning Heating and Plumbing.
candidates.rationale: Same regional residential home-services model with overlapping HVAC/plumbing buyer base; comparable multi-trade local contractor.

candidates.name: Hoffmann Brothers
candidates.description: We are on a mission to IMPROVE LIFE IN EVERY HOME. Hoffmann Brothers is a Saint Louis-based service business with over 400 team members operating across three divisions: Heating, Air Conditioning, Ventilation (HVAC), Electrical, Plumbing, and Appliance. We have hired, trained, and developed some of the most skilled service professionals in the industry which has enabled us to serve a broad range of customers to include individual home-owners, distribution centers, retail shopping centers, industrial manufacturing facilities, and large office complexes. Our comprehensive service offerings include geothermal heating and cooling, water-heater service and installations, ductless mini-split systems, ground source heat pumps, electrical panel service/installations, water-line repair/replacement, drain cleaning, lateral sewer line replacements, high efficiency residential heating and cooling equipment, appliance repair, appliance installation, and many other essential home and office services. Give us a call today at 314-664-3011(St. Louis) or 615-515-3015 (Nashville) and one of our customer service representatives will be happy to help you find the right solution for your home or business! Or you can visit us on the web at www.hoffmannbros.com. Hoffmann Brothers is currently hiring! To view openings and apply online, please visit http://hoffmannbros.com/careers.html. 2015 - Better Business Bureau (BBB) Customer Service Award 2016 - St. Louis Business Journal "Best Places to Work" 2018 - Post Dispatch "Best Places to Work" 2018 - ACHR NEWS’ Best Contractor to Work For award in the North Central and Canadian region 2019 - Air Conditioning Contractors of America (ACCA) Residential Contractor of the Year 2020 - St. Louis Business Journal "Best Places to Work" 2021 - St. Louis Post Dispatch "Top Places to Work" 2022 - St. Louis Post Dispatch "Top Places to Work" 2023 - St. Louis Business Journal "Best Places to Work" 2023 - Tennessean "Top Places to Work"
candidates.rationale: Same multi-trade residential home services model targeting homeowners; comparable HVAC, plumbing, and electrical offerings, with broader scale but strong overlap.

candidates.description: Performing Residential & Commercial Electric, Plumbing & HVAC Work Throughout Ohio. Call (614) 206-5401 to schedule an electrician!

candidates.name: Signature Heating Cooling Plumbing AND Electrical
candidates.description: Signature Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electrical was born out of a simple need: quality work done right in New Mexico. Today, after 9 years in business, we’ve grown rapidly and are proud to be the largest residential HVAC company in the state.
candidates.rationale: Same residential multi-trade home services model (HVAC, plumbing, electrical), comparable customer base, and similar regional local-service business.

candidates.name: Flame Heating Cooling Plumbing and Electrical
candidates.description: Family owned since 1949, FLAME Heating, Cooling, Plumbing and Electrical have installed more than 75,000 home comfort systems throughout Southeastern Michigan. With over 60 service vehicles to meet your home and business heating and cooling needs, FLAME Heating, Cooling, Plumbing and Electrical is Metro Detroit's most experienced and reliable service installation company. Providing numerous services 24/7 to its loyal customers has allowed FLAME Heating, Cooling, Plumbing and Electrical to build a business model as "the complete home comfort partner" as opposed to being another contracted vendor. With Same Day Service, Sunday, Holiday and Night service, FLAME has provided reliable services across the Metro Detroit area to tens of thousands of homes and businesses.
candidates.rationale: Same multi-trade residential home services model: HVAC, plumbing, electrical, serving homeowners in a regional metro market.

candidates.name: Estes Services
candidates.description: Our mission is to carry on the tradition of integrity and quality service that was started in 1949 when Estes was founded. We will always strive to employ the best people and provide the most efficient, cost effective service and equipment, as well as offer the best warranties available to our customers. Since our company was founded in 1949, literally hundreds of heating and air companies have come and gone in the metro Atlanta area. Most fail because the original owner did not cultivate the right management team and there was no one to take his place. Often a business retires with the owner! Luckily our company was able to make the transition from the first generation (N. B. Estes) to the second (Tommy Estes) and thrive since 1949. Most second generations don’t make it but we are in the unique position to have the third generation (Brian Estes) in place along with a management team centered around him and General Manager John Waldorf that will allow the company to continue an even greater growth path than ever before. We’re excited about the future of Estes Services and you can be sure that if you allow us to work for you we will do everything possible to be sure you receive the highest level of service – our reputation depends on it! Based on our volume we are in the top 5% of all the heating and air contractors in the country but we are still a family owned and operated business and will never lose the personal contact we now have with our customers. If you ever need to talk to ‘the owner’, give one of us a call because if something is not right we want to know about it! We sincerely care about our valued clients and would love for you to be part of the ‘Estes family’.
candidates.rationale: Same regional home services model; both sell residential HVAC and related trade services to homeowners.

candidates.name: L&S Mechanical
candidates.description: L&S Mechanical began as a Dallas-based contractor in 1985 and has grown over the years to have six locations out of Dallas, Fort Worth, Houston, San Antonio, and Austin. Over the past thirty years, we have become known as the premier provider of new home construction in the plumbing industry. In the last 10 years, we have added HVAC and electrical services to now offer the Tri-Trade Solution℠. We pride ourselves on having some of the most highly trained technicians in the industry. After delivering over 140,000 homes across the US, we know what builders and contractors are looking for; and we take that knowledge to all the homeowners we serve as well. From start to closing, we deliver excellence every stage of the way.
candidates.rationale: Same home-services tri-trade model: HVAC, plumbing, and electrical for homeowners, with comparable regional contractor positioning.
